left_direct_secondary.role: the released TRAIN A direct anchor; SECONDARY comparator, the system-versus-direct column only. Sealed bytes.

left_first_pass.role: cell B4b, the first pass of module M4b; the OWN-NULL leg of this read. Sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored.

authority.review_off_own_null: docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md; the TRAIN A own null of the REVIEW-OFF configuration, h_SLU 1.1218 pp and h_intent 1.0051 pp at CI95, which cell B4b had to borrow

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split. This read re-applies cell B4b's own clauses to a second realisation and measures that configuration's own noise; it does not enlarge, re-estimate or average the first pass's numbers.

contrasts.role: THE CLAUSE CONTRAST -- clause 1 of the decision rule
THE OWN NULL -- clause 2; its CI95 half-widths are outputs h_SLU_M4b and h_intent_M4b
THE STOP CONDITION -- must reproduce +1.1294 (pooled SLU) and -0.7117 (intent) CI95 lower bounds to the digit before any table of this cell is read

compared_with.note: the REVIEW-OFF configuration's own null, which cell B4b had to borrow; these are context, never a gate here

own_null_outputs.h_intent_m4b: CI95 half-width of (replicate minus B4b) for intent -- OUTPUT
own_null_outputs.h_slu_m4b: CI95 half-width of (replicate minus B4b) for pooled SLU -- OUTPUT

decision_rule.primary: official pooled SLU micro F1 (slurp-slu-official-train), natural mixture
decision_rule.stop_condition: the recomputed (B4b minus anchor) contrast must reproduce +1.1294 (pooled SLU) and -0.7117 (intent) CI95 lower bounds to the digit, and both comparators must reproduce their registered official and projection-v3 aggregates, before any table of this cell is read
decision_rule.symmetric_scorer: slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1 resolves gold from the SLURP devel split and refuses TRAIN sample ids. Owner decision 14 orders a TRAIN sibling, registered model-free in parallel; if it exists at read time its numbers are reported beside every official number, otherwise 'not evaluable on TRAIN' stays the honest statement. Never a gate here.

verdict.NOT REPLICATED: any of the three fails; the M4b harness-admission entry stays provisional with its obligation UNMET, the SLURP default plan keeps the slot-contracts v1 pins, and the owner is told
verdict.REPLICATED: the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta (replicate minus anchor) is greater than 0, AND the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta exceeds -1.0051 pp, AND the projection-v3 pooled SLU delta agrees in sign with the unprojected one

delta_convention: delta = right minus left, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for intent, scenario, action, row exact slot F1 and row SLU-F1, on both the clause contrast and the own null
net harmed rows per scenario, flagging any scenario with five or more (owner decision 17 of 2026-09-17), on both contrasts

the per-type date / time / media_type / transport_type / business_type / order_type / relation / event_name false-negative and false-positive decomposition of the B4b verdict, recomputed on this cell's own sealed outputs with the official scorer's own matching
the count of rows whose delivered (scenario, action) pair differs between the two passes

cost and duty cycle: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, task-contract calls, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, slot occupancy, utilisation, parked fraction, prompt/completion tokens and the minimum FIT margin
